verdict_schema.description: Machine-verifiable verdicts emitted by arifOS governance. Agents MUST treat these as terminal states, not suggestions. Compatibility with this site does not grant interpretation authority over them.

verdicts.SEAL: Verified — execution authorized within the sealed scope only
verdicts.PARTIAL: Subset verified — proceed only within the verified bounds
verdicts.UNKNOWN: Unmeasured — absence of data is not evidence; do not proceed on assumption
verdicts.SABAR: Cooling — deliberate pause before judgment; neither refusal nor approval
verdicts.HOLD: Human authority required — agent must stop; the human sovereign decides
verdicts.VOID: Invalid — claim or action rejected; do not retry without new evidence
